research_question: Which sorting implementation is faster across different input sizes?
hypothesis: Python built-in sorted will have lower median runtime than these teaching implementations on the specified random inputs.
methodology: Compare insertion sort, merge sort and built-in sorted on paired random integer inputs. Randomize algorithm order, check every result against a reference, and report repeated-trial timing distributions.
assumptions: Uniform random integer inputs are an illustrative workload, not representative of all applications.
limitations: Timings depend on the machine and background activity.
Built-in sorted and pure-Python implementations differ in implementation language as well as algorithm.
